opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment to help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focused on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focused on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that are open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK focused on professional performance, with the performing arts constituting the vast majority of their activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent), local authorities or universities in the UK displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities in the UK. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living.
